title: The best of Hamilton Private walking tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private, exclusive tour with your own local guide. Together with the professional guide, you will visit the most charming places in the city. You will have a chance to explore the city, while hearing fascinating facts and legends. Did you know Hamilton is New Zealand, The largest inland city? The Hamilton area has a history of 700-800 years of Maori occupation and settlement, highlighted by pa sites, traditional gardens and agricultural features along the Waikato River. You will be surprised how many stories are hidden in the streets, buildings and corners of Hamilton. Your charming guide will tell you what is special and unique about living in this city. Perfect for those who are visiting the city for the first time and want to get the most of it! 
* You will be guided by a local charismatic guide
* You will hear the stories and legends of the city
* You will visit the charming places
